title: Anki Review
done: No more cards to review in this session.
empty: No decks available. Open an Anki profile and reload.
media: Open this card in Anki to see its full content.
error.connection: Start Anki Desktop with AnkiConnect enabled, then reload.
error.api: AnkiConnect rejected the request. Check the add-on and Anki Desktop.
error.deck: Anki could not start a review for this deck.
error.changed: The active card changed in Anki. Start the deck again.
error.grade: Check Anki Desktop to see whether the grade was saved before continuing.
